newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index down in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index down in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Friday closed down by 3.42 points in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 599.66 from 603.08 on Thursday.
Trade volume was 2.54 million dinars against 2.36 million dinars.
Coke bottler SFBT lost 3.76 dinars to 121.73 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix eased 1.34 dinar to 43.17 dinars.
BIAT bank was up 1.78 dinar to 61.32 dinars. Airliner Tunis Air gained 0.98 dinar to 17.22 dinars.
